verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's own docs describe in-product delegation to its AI. Agentic mode lets models autonomously explore the web and use tools, the AI can hand work to parallel sub-agents via delegate_task, and automations or scheduled tasks run prompts on a schedule. Users supervise the agent's work with Allow/Deny approvals and approval modes. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that task delegation works in practice, since all evidence is first-party.
